title: Dnevni tržišni osvrt — prethodna raspoloživa sesija
title_en: Daily Market Brief — Previous Available Session
headline: Pregled posljednje raspoložive tržišne sesije temeljen na javno dostupnim podatcima o indeksima, digitalnoj imovini i stablecoin odstupanjima.
headline_en: Review of the latest available market session based on publicly available index, digital-asset and stablecoin-deviation observations.
summary: Promatrani burzovni indeksi zabilježili su pretežno pozitivan raspored kretanja. Najjaču promjenu pokazao je Nasdaq Composite (+3.11%), dok je najslabiji rezultat imao FTSE 100 (-0.29%).
U promatranom skupu digitalne imovine BTC je imao najizraženiju 24-satnu promjenu (-2.98%), dok je ETH zabilježio najslabije kretanje (-4.28%).
Najveće promatrano stablecoin odstupanje od referentne valute zabilježeno je kod FDUSD (-0.2762%). To je tržišno opažanje, a ne procjena rezervi ili otkupivosti.
Bitcoin: -5.29% u sedmodnevnoj usporedbi; zlato: -2.69% u sedmodnevnoj usporedbi; Brent nafta: -16.00% u sedmodnevnoj usporedbi.
summary_en: Observed equity indices showed a predominantly positive distribution of moves. Nasdaq Composite recorded the strongest change (+3.11%), while FTSE 100 was weakest (-0.29%).
Within the observed digital-asset set, BTC recorded the strongest 24-hour move (-2.98%), while ETH was weakest (-4.28%).
The largest observed stablecoin deviation from its reference currency was recorded for FDUSD (-0.2762%). This is a market observation, not a reserve or redemption assessment.
Bitcoin: -5.29% over the seven-day comparison; gold: -2.69% over the seven-day comparison; Brent crude: -16.00% over the seven-day comparison.
risk_note: Informativni analitički prikaz temeljen na javno dostupnim podatcima; nije investicijski savjet, preporuka ulaganja niti jamstvo budućeg kretanja.
